scientific_integrity: Exact proof and exact polynomial integration supplied; independent audit has not been performed. This result claims the distance distribution and moment plateau, not original discovery of the median cut-locus geometry.
scientific_limitations: Source confined to twelve half-face medians, with surface-area-uniform target. Does not classify global Fréchet minimizers, all sources, or historical novelty beyond inspected literature. Metric quotient proof is analytic; numerical tests corroborate it. Related cut-locus geometry appeared in Davis (2023).
title: A squared-distance plateau and exact intrinsic distance laws on tetrahedral face medians
